title: Biography Ebooks Online: How to Choose Your Next Read
seo_title: Biography Ebooks Online: How to Choose Your Next Read
description: Looking for biography ebooks online? Compare biography, autobiography and memoir, check an edition’s sources and preview, and choose a story that fits your interests.
intro: When looking for biography ebooks online, start with the person or period you want to understand. Then look beyond the cover: check who wrote the book, what kind of life story it tells and whether the edition gives you enough information to judge its approach.

sections.html: A biography describes a person’s life and is written by someone else. An autobiography is written by the person whose life it describes. A memoir usually concentrates on selected experiences or a particular theme rather than attempting to cover an entire life. These labels help you decide whether you want an outside perspective, a first-person account or a focused personal story.

sections.h2: Check the author’s approach and sources
sections.html:
Read the description and any available preview. Does the writer explain the period covered, distinguish documented events from interpretation and identify the materials used? Look for notes, references or an explanation of the research where appropriate. A dramatic title alone does not tell you how carefully a life has been represented.

Decide whether you want a broad introduction or a detailed study. A short, accessible account and a long, heavily documented biography can serve different readers; choose around your purpose rather than the page count alone.

Before purchasing, confirm the language, file format, reading arrangements and what the price includes. If illustrations, letters or family trees matter to you, inspect a sample on the screen you plan to use. Check the table of contents to see whether the structure matches the parts of the person’s life that interest you.

The Biographies & Memoirs category shows the titles currently available at Librava. The catalog includes a guide to writing your own life story; that is a writing resource, rather than a biography of a public figure. If you want to create a personal account, start with how to write a memoir. For keeping a record of your own experiences, see how to start journaling for a way to record your own experiences and observations.
